items.title: Giraffoidea
items.summary: Giraffoidea is a superfamily that contains Climacoceratidae and Giraffidae. The only living members are giraffes and okapis.

items.title: Uzhhorodskyi Raion
items.summary: Uzhhorodskyi Raion is one of the raions (districts) of Zakarpattia Oblast in western Ukraine. It's administrative center is the city of Uzhhorod, also the center of the surrounding oblast. Population: 255,000.
